Rashi on Berakhot 22a:11:1.hebrew: כי הנך תלת סבי - וכולהו לקולא:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:11:1.english: In accordance with these three elders - And all of them are for leniency.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:12:1.hebrew: אינו נוהג אלא בארץ - בשחיטת חולין יליף טעמא בפרק הזרוע:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:12:1.english: Is only practiced in the Land [of Israel] - In [tractate] Shechitat Chullin, [the Gemara] derives the reason in the chapter [entitled] HaZero'a.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:13:1.hebrew: חטה ושעורה וחרצן - שלשתן במפולת יד, דהוו להו כלאי זרעים וכלאי הכרם כאחת:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:13:1.english: Wheat and barley and a grape pit - All three of them [must be sown] in a [single] cast of the hand, so that they constitute diverse kinds of seeds and diverse kinds of the vineyard simultaneously.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:15:1.english: The immersion - [The immersion] of those who experienced a seminal emission.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:16:1.hebrew: חד תני - בבן עזאי, לחשה לתלמידים:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:16:1.english: One taught - With regard to Ben Azzai, he whispered it to the students.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:17:1.hebrew: משום בטול פריה ורביה - שהיו נמנעים מתשמיש מפני טורח הטבילה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:17:1.english: Due to the suspension of procreation - For they would abstain from marital relations because of the burden of immersion.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:18:1.hebrew: שמקילין בה - במרחצאות או בנתינת תשעה קבין:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:18:1.english: That they are lenient with regard to it - [By permitting immersion] in bathhouses, or by pouring nine kav [of water].

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:18:2.english: That they are stringent with regard to it - [By requiring immersion] in forty se'ah [of water].

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:19:1.hebrew: של טובלי שחרין - בעלי קריין הטובלין שחרית:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:19:1.english: Of those who immerse themselves in the morning - [This refers to] those who experienced a seminal emission who immerse in the morning.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:19:2.hebrew: והא איהו אמר כו' - לעיל בריש שמעתין:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:19:2.english: Isn't he the one who said, etc. - Above, at the beginning of our discussion.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:19:3.hebrew: אפשר בנתינה - תשעה קבין. ואף על גב דלא תנא לקמן אלא בחולה, סתם תלמידי חכמים חולים הם, כדאמר במסכת נדרים (דף מט:): כמאן מצלינן אקצירי ואמריעי? כרבי יוסי. קצירי — חולין, מריעי — רבנן:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:19:3.english: It is possible by pouring - [Namely, by pouring] nine kav [of water]. And even though it is taught below only with regard to a sick person, ordinary Torah scholars are [considered] sick, as [the Gemara] says in Tractate Nedarim (49b): "In accordance with whose view do we pray for the sick and the ailing? In accordance with Rabbi Yose." "Ktzirei" [refers to] the sick; "merei" [refers to] the Rabbis.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:1:1.hebrew: לא תימא - במתני' מברך, אלא מהרהר:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:1:1.english: Do not say - [That] in the Mishnah, [one] recites a blessing; rather, [he] contemplates.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:20:1.hebrew: גדר גדול גדרו - במה שהצריכו בארבעים סאה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:20:1.english: They established a great fence - In that they required [immersion in] forty se'ah [of water].

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:20:2.hebrew: שתבע אשה - אותה אשה פנויה היתה, וחכמים גזרו על היחוד אף על הפנויה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:20:2.english: Who solicited a woman - That woman was unmarried, and the Sages decreed against seclusion even with an unmarried woman.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:21:1.hebrew: אתם מזלזלים - לנהוג כרבי יהודה בן בתירא:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:21:1.english: You disdain [it] - [By] acting in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:21:2.english: It is possible in bathhouses - [Which are] heated.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:22:1.hebrew: קאי כוותך - דבעי טבילה זו במקוה כשאר טבילות:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:22:1.english: Holds in accordance with you - For he requires this immersion [to be] in a ritual bath, like other immersions.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:23:1.english: In a tub of water - [A] tub.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:23:2.hebrew: נראה בעיני דה"ג א"ר אלעאי הלכה כו' - ולא גרסינן מסייע ליה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:23:2.english: It appears to me that this is the reading: “Rabbi El’ai said: The halakha [is], etc.” - And we do not read: “It supports him.”

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:24:1.hebrew: תקן חצבא - ליתן מים לתלמידים עליהם שחרית, קודם קריאת התורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:24:1.english: Prepared a jug - To pour water over the students in the morning, before the reading of the Torah.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:24:2.hebrew: לא שנו - דסגי בנתינה, אלא בחולה שראה קרי לאונסו:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:24:2.english: They only taught - That pouring [water] is sufficient [was taught] only for a sick person who experienced a seminal emission involuntarily.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:24:3.hebrew: המרגיל - וממשיך את הקרי עליו, שמשמש מטתו:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:24:3.english: Who brings [it] on - And draws the seminal emission upon himself, in that he engages in marital relations.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:25:1.hebrew: אתבר חצביה - אינו צריך לנו, דחולה לאונסו לא שכיח:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:25:1.english: His jug is broken - It is not needed by us, for a sick person [who emits] involuntarily is not common.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:3:1.english: Rabbi Yehuda rendered them - [This refers] to the Grace after Meals.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:3:2.hebrew: כהלכות ד"א - שמותר לשנותה בעל קרי, כדבריו:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:3:2.english: Like Hilkhot Derekh Eretz - For one who experienced a seminal emission is permitted to study it, in accordance with his statement.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:4:1.hebrew: מה להלן באימה - דכתיב: ״וירא העם וינועו״ וגו' (שמות כ):
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:4:1.english: Just as there [it was] with dread - As it is written: “And the people saw, and they trembled, etc.” (Exodus 20).

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:5:1.hebrew: מכאן אמרו - כל הטמאים מותרים בתורה, שאף הם יכולים להיות באימה וברתת, אבל בעל קרי אינו אלא מתוך קלות ראש וזחות הדעת:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:5:1.english: From here [the Sages] stated - All [other] impure people are permitted [to study] Torah, for they too can be in awe and trembling; but one who experienced a seminal emission [comes to this] only from levity and haughtiness.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:5:2.hebrew: ובועלי נדות - אם טבלו לקריין לדברי תורה, הטבילה אינה עולה להם לטהרם מטומאת בועל נדה, שהיא שבעת ימים; אבל לתקנת עזרא עולה להם, כדתנן במתניתין: זב שראה קרי, ונדה כו' צריכין טבילה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:5:2.english: And those who engaged in intercourse with menstruating women - If they immersed for their seminal emission for [the purpose of studying] words of Torah, the immersion does not count for them to purify them from the impurity of one who had intercourse with a menstruating woman, which [lasts] seven days; but for the enactment of Ezra, it counts for them, as we learned in our Mishnah: “A zav who experienced a seminal emission, and a menstruating woman, etc., require immersion.”

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:1.hebrew: ברגיליות - במשניות השגורות בפיו, שהוא מוציאן מפיו במרוצה, ואין צריך להאריך בהן:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:1.english: In familiar [texts] - In Mishnayot that are fluent in his mouth, for he utters them from his mouth swiftly and does not need to linger over them.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:2.english: That he not expound - [Delving] into the reasons behind their explanations.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:3.hebrew: ואינו מציע את המדרש גרסינן - מפני שצריך הוא תמיד להזכיר בו את הפסוקים שהוא דורש:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:3.english: “And he does not expound upon the Midrash” is our reading - Because he constantly needs to mention in it the verses that he is expounding.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:4.english: Mentions [of God’s name] - [Those] that are in the verses being expounded.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:5.hebrew: לא יכנס למדרש כל עיקר - לא להציע ולא לשנות, אבל לבית המדרש הוא נכנס ושותק:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:5.english: He may not enter into midrash at all - Neither to expound nor to recite, but into the study hall he may enter and remain silent.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:6.hebrew: הלכות דרך ארץ - כגון דרכן של ת"ח, שהיא ברייתא, ופרק בן עזאי — הנותן ארבעה דברים אל לבו:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:6:6.english: The laws of proper conduct - Such as [the tractate] “The Conduct of Torah Scholars,” which is a baraita, and the chapter of Ben Azzai — [which begins:] “One who takes four things to heart.”

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:8:1.english: Stammering and reciting - He was one who had experienced a seminal emission.

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:9:1.hebrew: נראה בעיני דה"ג א"ר אלעאי הלכה כו' - ולא גרסינן מסייע ליה:
Rashi on Berakhot 22a:9:1.english: It appears to me that this is the reading: "Rabbi El’ai said: The halakha [is], etc." - And we do not read: "It supports him."

Rashi on Berakhot 22a:9:2.english: In the name of our teacher - [This refers to] Rav.
